businesses.business: healthcare products and technology (medical, dental, health information)

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures medical-surgical, dental and orthodontic, health information software, and purification and filtration products. Sells to hospitals, clinicians, dental practices, and payers. Spun off from 3M in 2024.

primary_products.value: wound care and infection prevention products; dental and orthodontic products; health information software; filtration and purification products; ostomy and skin health products

primary_services.value: health information software and coding services; technical support and consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, dental practices and labs, orthodontists, health systems, payers, food and beverage processors; B2G: government and public hospitals and health agencies

end_markets.value: hospitals and healthcare; dental and orthodontics; health information management; food and beverage filtration

revenue_model.value: product sales: medical, dental and filtration products and consumables; subscription: health information software and coding platforms; service fees: software support and professional services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures medical, dental and filtration products sold to providers and distributors; software / platform: health information systems sold to hospitals and payers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: medical-surgical, dental solutions, health information systems, purification and filtration

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams to hospitals, dental practices and health systems; distributors / dealers: medical and dental distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices requiring FDA clearance and EU MDR approval, health data privacy rules such as HIPAA
